concerns.analysis: The source document is a user guide that relies heavily on screenshots of UI elements (buttons, links, form fields) to complete its instructions (e.g., 'Click [Image]'). These images are highly meaningful for understanding the steps. However, in the HTML output, these images are entirely missing and replaced with HTML comments like '<!-- image without data: ... -->'. concerns.description: Displaced hyperlinks: 8 link(s) extracted as standalone elements instead of inline text
concerns.analysis: standalone_links=8, examples=['https://myncid.nc.gov/', 'https://myncid.nc.gov/', 'https://myncid.nc.gov/']. Links should be inline within paragraphs, not separate blocks.

concerns.description: List numbering restart(s): 7 ordered list(s) restart numbering at 1 instead of continuing sequence
concerns.analysis: restart_count=7. Examples: p1: 5 single-item ordered lists (fragmented); p2: list restarts at 1 (prev page 1 ended at 6); p3: list restarts at 1 (prev page 2 ended at 4). Ordered lists that restart numbering suggest content was split across page breaks and not reassembled.

concerns.description: Links displaced to end of page: 8 link(s) clustered at bottom of 3 page(s) instead of inline in text
concerns.analysis: displaced_link_pages=3, total_displaced=8. Links appear as standalone elements at the end of pages rather than being inline in the paragraph text.

concerns.description: Header/footer elements retained in output (9): MyNCID User Guide * Ver 1.0; September 23, 2025; Page 1 of 3
concerns.analysis: header_footer_count=9. Header/footer elements are present in extraction data. This is common in multi-page government PDFs and is typically cosmetic — the renderer strips them from HTML output.
